name: effectivePolygenicityOfEffects
note: prediction equals truth to machine precision in every cell: the oracle is the formula, not a measurement
regime: M = 5000 variants of which k carry EQUAL-MAGNITUDE effects with random signs and the rest are exactly zero; the oracle is the count of nonzero effects. Equal magnitude is what makes 'effective number of loci' unambiguous -- under Gaussian effects the ratio is k/3, and that value is carried as a competing cell so the dependence on the effect distribution is explicit
